title: Mediterranean Fregola Risotto
description: A flavorful and hearty Mediterranean-inspired risotto dish made with fregola and kissed by the essence of monsoon herbs.
instructions: Heat the kissed olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the monsoon herbs and cook for an additional minute.
Add the fregola and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the diced tomatoes and vegetable broth, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 15-20 minutes, until the fregola is tender.
Stir in the risotto and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional monsoon herbs if desired.
